notes: Greedy decoding, the setting of the reported evaluations. max_source_tokens is the per-sentence limit (longer sentences are refused): quality holds up to 128 source tokens and collapses above it (WMT24++ en->zh, items over 128 tokens: BLEU 6.91). A degenerate repetition loop stops generation.
loop_guard: stop when the tail repeats a 1-8 token pattern max(4, ceil(8/p)) times; keep one copy; warn
